item.title: MiBeeVision: An Understanding Engine for MiBeeNvr's Recordings
item.description: The NVR keeps one promise: footage is always being recorded. Once the recordings pile up, a new problem appears — who watches dozens of gigabytes of playback? Scrubbing timelines afterwards to find “when did that person walk in” still relies on human eyes. MiBeeNvr’s browser-side AI watches the live view while the page is open, and stops the moment the tab closes. What is missing is a component that runs independently of any page, around the clock, over the recordings.
